# orca cheatsheet — embedded browser (reviewer / integrator)

Flags and notes for orca 1.4.218, straight from `orca agent-context --json`. Use this instead of
`orca … --help`. A command missing here, or an `orca --version` other than the one above: use that command's `--help`.
Every command takes `--json`.
Browser commands act on the Orca embedded browser; `orca tab list` first, then target by `--page <id>` where the command takes it.

## Tabs and navigation

### `orca tab list`
List open browser tabs.
```
orca tab list [--worktree <selector|all>] [--show-profile] [--json]
```

### `orca tab current`
Show the current browser tab.
```
orca tab current [--worktree <selector|all>] [--json]
```

### `orca tab show`
Show one browser tab by page id.
```
orca tab show --page <id> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca tab create`
Create a new browser tab in the current worktree.
```
orca tab create [--url <url>] [--worktree <selector>] [--profile <id>] [--json]
```

### `orca tab switch`
Switch the active browser tab.
```
orca tab switch (--index <n> | --page <id>) [--worktree <selector>] [--focus] [--json]
```

### `orca tab close`
Close a browser tab.
```
orca tab close [--index <n>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca goto`
Navigate the active browser tab to a URL.
```
orca goto --url <url> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca reload`
Reload the active browser tab.
```
orca reload [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca back`
Navigate back in browser history.
```
orca back [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca forward`
Navigate forward in browser history.
```
orca forward [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca wait`
Wait for element, text, URL, load state, JS condition, or timeout.
```
orca wait [--selector <sel>] [--timeout <ms>] [--text <text>] [--url <pattern>] [--load <state>] [--fn <js>] [--state <hidden|visible>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

## Reading the page

### `orca screenshot`
Capture a viewport screenshot of the active browser tab.
```
orca screenshot [--format <png|jpeg>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca full-screenshot`
Capture a full-page screenshot (beyond viewport).
```
orca full-screenshot [--format <png|jpeg>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca snapshot`
Capture an accessibility snapshot of the active browser tab.
```
orca snapshot [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca eval`
Evaluate JavaScript in the browser page context.
```
orca eval --expression <js> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca exec`
Run any agent-browser command against the active browser tab.
```
orca exec --command "<agent-browser command>" [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca console`
Show captured console log entries.
```
orca console [--limit <n>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca network`
Show captured network requests.
```
orca network [--limit <n>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca get`
Get element property (text, html, value, url, title, count, box).
```
orca get --what <property> [--element <ref>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca is`
Check element state (visible, enabled, checked).
```
orca is --what <state> --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca find`
Find element by semantic locator and perform action.
```
orca find --locator <type> --value <text> --action <action> [--text <text>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

## Device

### `orca viewport`
Set browser viewport size.
```
orca viewport --width <w> --height <h> [--scale <n>] [--mobile] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca set device`
Emulate a device.
```
orca set device --name <device> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca set media`
Set color scheme and reduced motion preferences.
```
orca set media [--color-scheme <dark|light>] [--reduced-motion <reduce|no-preference>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

## Input

### `orca click`
Click a browser element by ref.
```
orca click --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca dblclick`
Double-click element by ref.
```
orca dblclick --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca hover`
Hover over a browser element by ref.
```
orca hover --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca fill`
Clear and fill a browser input by ref.
```
orca fill --element <ref> --value <text> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca type`
Type text at the current browser focus.
```
orca type --input <text> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca keypress`
Press a key (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, etc.).
```
orca keypress --key <name> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca inserttext`
Insert text without key events.
```
orca inserttext --text <text> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca select`
Select a dropdown option by ref.
```
orca select --element <ref> --value <value> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca check`
Check a checkbox/radio by ref.
```
orca check --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca uncheck`
Uncheck a checkbox/radio by ref.
```
orca uncheck --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca focus`
Focus a browser element by ref.
```
orca focus --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca scroll`
Scroll the browser viewport.
```
orca scroll --direction <up|down> [--amount <pixels>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca scrollintoview`
Scroll element into view.
```
orca scrollintoview --element <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca drag`
Drag from one element to another.
```
orca drag --from <ref> --to <ref> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca mouse move`
Move mouse to x,y coordinates.
```
orca mouse move --x <n> --y <n> [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca mouse down`
Press mouse button.
```
orca mouse down [--button <left|right|middle>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca mouse up`
Release mouse button.
```
orca mouse up [--button <left|right|middle>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca mouse wheel`
Scroll wheel.
```
orca mouse wheel --dy <n> [--dx <n>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca dialog accept`
Accept a browser dialog.
```
orca dialog accept [--text <text>] [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```

### `orca dialog dismiss`
Dismiss a browser dialog.
```
orca dialog dismiss [--worktree <selector>] [--json]
```
